name: Industry Next Work Market
summary: A public board connecting jobs, first tasks, accountable organizations, and explicit token or credit reward terms.

authentication.signature_verification: client-side against the wallet public key

organizations.name: Industry Next
organizations.acceptance: A named founder or accountable project lead accepts work.

reward_rails.name: AI Credits
reward_rails.quantity_terms: Set in a written kickoff before use.

opportunities.title: Halation Lead
opportunities.outcome: Own the image diary, publish with it, and build its first small circle.

reward.amount_terms: Allocation is set in a written kickoff before use.

opportunities.title: Playlist Editor + Listener Growth Lead
opportunities.outcome: Create authored listening worlds and help good music earn real, repeat listening.

reward.amount_terms: Scope, share percentage, eligible revenue, credit, ownership, reporting, payout timing, and exit terms are agreed in writing before work begins.

opportunities.title: TAG Build Lead
opportunities.outcome: Make a tiny social relay playable, test it with three live groups, and leave a public release plus technical handoff.

reward.amount_terms: Credits cover AI model and tool usage. Cash costs and paid services require a separate agreement before work begins.

opportunities.title: Small Social Systems Builder
opportunities.outcome: Choose one underbuilt social behavior, make it playable with a real group, and publish the system for the next builder to fork.

reward.amount_terms: AI credits are bounded operating support. Cash, ownership, paid services, employment, and contractor terms require a separate written agreement before work begins.

opportunities.title: Run Halation's first 30-day operating loop
opportunities.outcome: Publish, invite, learn, and recommend continue, revise, or close.
opportunities.acceptance: Public work, real invitations, a short evidence trail, and a written decision.
opportunities.reward: Inside the funded lead brief; not a separate bounty.

opportunities.title: Sequence three songs
opportunities.outcome: Show editorial taste with three songs in order and a short reason they belong together.
opportunities.acceptance: Three links, one sequence, and a short editorial reason.
opportunities.reward: Application proof; no commercial use without agreement.

opportunities.title: Make the TAG relay restartable
opportunities.outcome: Prototype the tag, dare, proof, pass, and recap loop as a mobile web room a group can choose to restart.
opportunities.acceptance: A working handoff tested with the first real group.
opportunities.reward: Inside the provided AI-credit build budget.

opportunities.title: Ship one ritual with one real group
opportunities.outcome: Choose the real group first, run one clickable or facilitated ritual, and leave a one-page field note about the handoff.
opportunities.acceptance: One group completes one live loop and can say whether it should restart.
opportunities.reward: Inside the provided AI-credit build budget.

opportunities.title: Repair one broken door
opportunities.outcome: Rewrite one vague public invitation as a complete door with WHO, FIRST MOVE, TERMS, and YES.
opportunities.acceptance: One public source link and one rewritten door after claim confirmation.
opportunities.reward: Unpaid editorial field exercise; contributor retains rights and publication requires written approval.

opportunities.title: Offer one enjoyable hour
opportunities.outcome: Choose one contribution score, stop after sixty minutes, and leave only what was enjoyable to make.
opportunities.acceptance: One confirmed place, one completed Notice, Welcome, Connect, or Remix score, and an optional artifact share.
opportunities.reward: Unpaid voluntary editorial field experiment; contributor retains ownership and sharing is optional.
